mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_graph.enterprise (name, uscc, industry, legal_person, registered_capital, establish_date, address, data_source, last_synced_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{uscc}, #{industry}, #{legalPerson}, #{registeredCapital}, #{establishDate}, #{address}, #{dataSource}, #{lastSyncedAt})

INSERT INTO schema_graph.supply_chain_relation (from_enterprise_id, to_enterprise_id, relation_type, first_coop_date, last_coop_date, total_transactions, total_amount, core_enterprise_id, level) VALUES
(#{item.fromEnterpriseId}, #{item.toEnterpriseId}, #{item.relationType}, #{item.firstCoopDate}, #{item.lastCoopDate}, #{item.totalTransactions}, #{item.totalAmount}, #{item.coreEnterpriseId}, #{item.level})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_graph.enterprise_role WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_graph.enterprise_role (enterprise_id, role, core_enterprise_id, coop_duration_years, coop_enterprise_count, influence_level, credibility_level) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{role}, #{coreEnterpriseId}, #{coopDurationYears}, #{coopEnterpriseCount}, #{influenceLevel}, #{credibilityLevel})
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_graph.enterprise_role SET role = #{role}, core_enterprise_id = #{coreEnterpriseId}, coop_duration_years = #{coopDurationYears}, coop_enterprise_count = #{coopEnterpriseCount}, influence_level = #{influenceLevel}, credibility_level = #{credibilityLevel}, calculated_at = NOW() WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_graph.enterprise_position_analysis WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_graph.enterprise_position_analysis (enterprise_id, in_core_chain, distance_to_core, upstream_stable, downstream_stable, credibility, credibility_reason) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{inCoreChain}, #{distanceToCore}, #{upstreamStable}, #{downstreamStable}, #{credibility}, #{credibilityReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_graph.enterprise_position_analysis SET in_core_chain = #{inCoreChain}, distance_to_core = #{distanceToCore}, upstream_stable = #{upstreamStable}, downstream_stable = #{downstreamStable}, credibility = #{credibility}, credibility_reason = #{credibilityReason}, calculated_at = NOW() WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_graph.abnormal_relation WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} ORDER BY detected_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_graph.abnormal_relation (enterprise_id, abnormal_type, severity, description, evidence, status) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{abnormalType}, #{severity}, #{description}, CAST(#{evidence, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), COALESCE(#{status}, 'OPEN'))

INSERT INTO schema_graph.abnormal_relation (enterprise_id, abnormal_type, severity, description, evidence) VALUES
(#{item.enterpriseId}, #{item.abnormalType}, #{item.severity}, #{item.description}, CAST(#{item.evidence, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_graph.abnormal_relation SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
